# Apex Digital SA — Extended Full Knowledge Repository (RAG Matrix)

## Overview & Corporate Identity
Apex Digital SA (Pty) Ltd is a South African digital engineering agency and web architecture firm specializing in custom-coded corporate websites, speed-hardened headless platforms, Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), and transactional e-commerce engines.

## Technology Stack & Architectural Standards
Apex Digital rejects generic drag-and-drop website builders (Wix, Squarespace) and unoptimized CMS setups. All primary platforms are built using:
1. **Core Language Engine:** HTML5 Semantic Markup, Vanilla CSS3 (Custom Properties & Responsive Design Systems), and Modern ES2026 JavaScript.
2. **Performance Shield:** Pre-rendered static DOM delivered via global Edge CDN networks (<15ms latency).
3. **Core Engineering Standard:** 100% Custom Code Architecture, zero CMS plugin dependencies, 100% Google & AI Search Schema Graph integration, and 100% POPIA Privacy Compliance.
4. **South African Privacy & Data Security:** Built-in compliance with the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA), secure cookie consent managers, SSL/TLS encryption, and sanitized serverless intake handlers.
5. **E-Commerce Gateway Integrations:** PayFast, Yoco, Ozow, and automated courier shipping rate APIs (uAfrica / ShipLogic).

## RAG Question & Answer Knowledge Matrix

Q: Why custom-coded architecture instead of standard WordPress or Wix templates?
A: Custom-coded architecture frees your business from the rigid constraints and script bloat of generic CMS templates, allowing us to build an uncompromising digital reflection of your brand. While we can deploy on WordPress or Wix when specific client workflows demand it, our custom engineering gives us granular control over both the technical backend (structured data, Core Web Vitals, and AI search crawlers) and the frontend conversion UX. This ensures your website is engineered to rank on Google and AI search engines, load instantly, and actively convert traffic—all with 100% full source code ownership and zero proprietary platform lock-in.

Q: What are the typical turnaround timelines for custom web builds?
A: Project timelines are structured around agile engineering sprints: Starter single-page landing pages typically deploy within 3 to 5 business days, Standard multi-page commercial platforms within 7 to 14 business days, and Pro builds or complex web applications from 14+ business days. Timelines are collaborative benchmarks and depend directly on the prompt delivery of brand assets, copy, media, and sign-offs. Apex operates with disciplined sprint velocity, but build speed is anchored by how swiftly project assets are provided.

Q: How does Apex ensure local POPIA compliance and data governance?
A: We integrate industry-standard data protection protocols into every build—including SSL/TLS transport encryption, secure form routing, and transparent legal policy notices (POPIA Privacy Notices, Terms of Service, and Cookie Policies). Because regulatory requirements vary by industry vertical, we actively liaise with each client to configure compliance disclaimers and privacy notices tailored specifically to their commercial operations, ensuring total legal transparency from day one.

Q: Do you handle domain registration, hosting infrastructure, and business emails?
A: Yes. Apex Digital collaborates directly with specialized, enterprise-grade cloud and infrastructure partners to provide end-to-end operational coverage. We orchestrate DNS configuration, cloud hosting deployment, domain provisioning, and business email integration (such as Google Workspace or Microsoft 365) in tandem with our infrastructure partners. Every deployment is tailored to your business architecture—contact us during your discovery consultation for specific setup requirements.

Q: Who owns the website code upon completion, and how are ongoing updates handled?
A: You own 100% of your website code, repository access, and design assets upon full project completion—free from monthly builder hostage fees. To maintain peak operational performance, we offer structured ongoing maintenance tiers: pure technical support (security hardening, continuous backups, and framework updates) as well as hybrid Growth tiers (technical maintenance + ongoing SEO authority to preserve ranking power). Bespoke SLA retainers are also custom-tailored post-launch based on your team's exact operational requirements.

Q: Where is Apex Digital SA located?
A: Apex Digital SA is based in Durban, KwaZulu-Natal, South Africa, serving corporate and enterprise clients across South Africa (Johannesburg, Cape Town, Durban, Pretoria) and international markets.

Q: How do clients get started with an Apex Digital web project?
A: Clients can initiate a project by submitting their requirements via the interactive strategy intake form at https://apexdigitalsa.com/#strategy or by contacting Apex Digital directly on WhatsApp at +27 69 522 4226.
